body.heading: Where in the world is Austria?
paragraphs: Austria is a country in Western Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Austria is Vienna.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Austria is German.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Austria is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Austria?
paragraphs: Austria covers about 84,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about twice the size of Netherlands.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Vienna was the capital of emperors. Families tour Schönbrunn's palace and zoo, ride the giant Ferris wheel at the Prater and eat cake in grand cafés.
Hallstatt is a storybook village squeezed between a lake and salt mountains — so pretty it inspired a film kingdom's look. The whole lake district sparkles.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Austria on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Austria in one breath: a country in Western Europe, capital Vienna, where people speak German and pay with the euro.
